pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Needs 4.5 V or more: use VIN

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: 3.3 V HIGH when motion is detected, safe for the ESP32

gotchas.text: After power-up it needs about a minute to settle and may trigger by itself during that time.
